$comment: Single source of truth for the Content-Security-Policy. Layout.astro emits it as a <meta> tag (security/csp.mjs drops the header-only directives), public/_headers sends the full policy as a header (scripts/build-headers.mjs writes it into dist/_headers), and scripts/check-csp.mjs checks the built site against it. The site has no inline scripts: every script is a file.
